question: Magnoliophyta are the flowering plants which are also known as:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Angiosperms**__ .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Angiosperms__**

 
 
• They are** flowering **and **seed-producing plants**.
 
• It consists of** 64 orders**, **416 families**, approximately **13,000** known** genera**, and** 3,00,000** known **species**.
 
• Their seeds develop in the **ovaries of flowers** and are surrounded by a **protective fruit**.
 
• Examples of angiosperms are** fruits** (**apple, mango, banana,** etc), **vegetables** (**potato, bitter gourd, beetroot,** etc.), **grains** ( **Rice, wheat, dal,** etc.), and **flowers** ( **Marigold, rose, jasmine**, etc.).
